summary: Konami's gothic action franchise, covering the classic linear games, exploration-era Metroidvanias, 3D entries, Lords of Shadow reboot branch, mobile/arcade spin-offs, and major modern collections.

entries.title: Castlevania

emulation.emulator: None for PC collection; Mesen for original builds
emulation.notes: Use PC collection for main play.

primary.why: The Anniversary Collection is the most practical official route for the NES/Famicom-era original on modern hardware, with PC offering the cleanest capture/display path.
primary.how_to_play: Play Castlevania Anniversary Collection on PC; use Famicom/NES emulation only for exact original-hardware comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use original Famicom Disk System/NES builds if comparing regional behavior.

entries.title: Vampire Killer

emulation.notes: Use accurate MSX2 emulation.

primary.why: Vampire Killer is a distinct MSX2 Castlevania title rather than a straight NES duplicate, and the MSX2 original is the only documented platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play with openMSX using clean integer scaling.

entries.remaster_caveats: Treat as a distinct game from the Famicom/NES Castlevania.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Japanese version was not part of the Anniversary Collection Japanese-version update, so use Famicom Disk System separately for exact Japanese comparison.

entries.title: Haunted Castle

entries.remaster_caveats: Haunted Castle Revisited is a remake, not a replacement for evaluating the original arcade game.

entries.title: Castlevania Chronicles

emulation.notes: Upscale PS1 release.

primary.why: The Sharp X68000 game was re-released on PlayStation as Castlevania Chronicles with new features, making the PlayStation version the most complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation Castlevania Chronicles release through DuckStation, or the PSN version on compatible PlayStation hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use X68000 separately for pure original-computer preservation.

entries.title: Castlevania: Rondo of Blood

emulation.emulator: Mednafen for original; none for PS4 route
emulation.notes: Use Requiem for official modern play.

primary.why: Requiem is the official modern collection route for Rondo of Blood and Symphony of the Night, based on the versions previously featured in Dracula X Chronicles.
primary.how_to_play: Play Castlevania Requiem on PS4/PS5 compatibility; use Mednafen for exact PC Engine CD original comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Dracula X Chronicles also contains the 2.5D remake and should be tracked separately as its own collection entry.

entries.title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night

emulation.emulator: Mednafen/Kronos for Saturn secondary; DuckStation for PS1 comparison
emulation.notes: Use Requiem for main play and Saturn emulation only for exclusive content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official PS4 collection plus Saturn secondary

primary.why: Requiem is the official modern route for Symphony of the Night, while the Saturn port has exclusive areas/characters at lower technical polish.
primary.how_to_play: Play Castlevania Requiem on PS4/PS5 compatibility; play the Saturn version separately only for its exclusive content.

secondary.exclusive_content: Saturn version has exclusive areas and playable Maria content not present in the standard PlayStation-derived route.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the Saturn-exclusive areas and Maria route.
secondary.why: The Saturn release is separate from the PlayStation/Requiem lineage.

entries.remaster_caveats: Saturn content is not part of the usual modern route; mobile ports are convenient but not the fidelity pick.

entries.title: Castlevania Legends

emulation.notes: Use accurate Game Boy/Super Game Boy emulation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Game Boy original with clean scaling

primary.why: Legends is a Game Boy/Super Game Boy release with no modern collection route documented in the public list.
primary.how_to_play: Play with SameBoy or original hardware; use Super Game Boy mode if preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later continuity status debates do not change the version recommendation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Legacy of Darkness.

entries.title: Castlevania: The Adventure ReBirth

primary.how_to_play: Play on an original Wii with owned WiiWare access or through Dolphin from a preserved legal dump.

entries.remaster_caveats: Delisted WiiWare availability makes preservation harder; do not conflate with the original Game Boy title.

entries.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse

primary.why: Belmont's Curse is scheduled for October 15, 2026, after the archive date of June 18, 2026, so final fidelity/content comparisons cannot be completed yet.
primary.how_to_play: Revisit after release; do not assign a definitive platform before final builds and reviews exist.

entries.remaster_caveats: Future mainline entry; compare PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Switch after release.

entries.title: Castlevania: Order of Shadows

entries.title: Castlevania Judgment

emulation.notes: Upscale Wii version.

primary.why: Judgment is the Castlevania fighting-game spin-off and was released on Wii only.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Dolphin at high internal resolution or on original Wii hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Spin-off fighting game, not a mainline action-adventure entry.

entries.title: Castlevania: The Arcade

emulation.notes: Use original arcade hardware where possible.

primary.why: The Arcade is a dedicated arcade title with no home release.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original cabinet/hardware if available; otherwise preserve as arcade-only documentation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No home conversion documented.

entries.title: Castlevania Puzzle: Encore of the Night

emulation.notes: Requires compatible iOS/Windows Phone route.

primary.why: Encore of the Night is a puzzle spin-off based on Symphony of the Night and shipped on iOS, then Windows Phone.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned compatible mobile route if available; otherwise archive as a delisted/mobile-era spin-off.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile store availability can block current play.

entries.title: Castlevania: Harmony of Despair

emulation.notes: Original hardware/account ownership may be required.

primary.why: Harmony of Despair is a multiplayer digital title released on Xbox Live Arcade and PlayStation Network; neither has a PC route documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play on compatible Xbox/PlayStation hardware with the digital release and DLC where owned.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC/current collection release documented.

entries.title: Castlevania: Grimoire of Souls

emulation.notes: Requires Apple Arcade-compatible hardware/account.

primary.why: The original free-to-play Android/iOS version was shut down and delisted, while the Apple Arcade rerelease removed monetization elements.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Apple Arcade on a compatible Apple device.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original free-to-play version ended in 2020.

entries.title: Konami Collector's Series: Castlevania & Contra

emulation.notes: Use native Windows/GOG release.

primary.why: This Windows compilation includes the NES Castlevania trilogy plus Contra, Super C, and Jackal, and was later released digitally on GOG.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GOG/Windows release if collecting the compilation itself; use Anniversary Collection for the Castlevania games alone.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not the best route for the Castlevania games themselves, but relevant as a compilation.

entries.title: Castlevania: Double Pack

emulation.notes: Use GBA emulation for this cartridge compilation.

primary.why: Double Pack combines Harmony of Dissonance and Aria of Sorrow on one GBA cartridge; the individual games are better served by Advance Collection.
primary.how_to_play: Play via mGBA if archiving the combined cartridge; otherwise use Advance Collection for the included games.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use Advance Collection for modern play of the included games.

entries.title: Castlevania: The Dracula X Chronicles

emulation.notes: Upscale the PSP collection.

primary.why: This PSP collection includes a 2.5D remake of Rondo of Blood plus the original Rondo and Symphony of the Night with new features.
primary.how_to_play: Play through PPSSPP at high internal resolution, or on original PSP/Vita hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Track the 2.5D remake as collection-specific content; it is not the same as the original PC Engine Rondo.

entries.title: Castlevania Requiem

emulation.notes: Use PS4/PS5 compatibility.

primary.why: Requiem is the PS4 collection of Rondo of Blood and Symphony of the Night, based on the emulated ports from The Dracula X Chronicles.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS4 or compatible PS5.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC version documented; Symphony's Saturn exclusives are outside this collection.

entries.title: Castlevania Anniversary Collection

emulation.notes: Use native PC collection.

primary.why: The collection gathers the NES trilogy, The Adventure, Belmont's Revenge, Bloodlines, Super Castlevania IV, and Kid Dracula with a digital booklet and later Japanese-version update.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PC version for the cleanest display/capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Compilation entry; individual games still carry precise best-version picks.

entries.title: Castlevania Advance Collection

emulation.notes: Use native PC collection.

primary.why: The collection includes Circle of the Moon, Harmony of Dissonance, Aria of Sorrow, and Dracula X plus gallery/music extras; PC is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Castlevania Advance Collection on PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: Compilation entry; individual games still have their own entries.

entries.title: Castlevania Dominus Collection

emulation.notes: Use native PC collection.

primary.why: Dominus Collection includes the three Nintendo DS Castlevania games, Haunted Castle, and Haunted Castle Revisited; PC is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Castlevania Dominus Collection on PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: Compilation entry; original DS hardware remains the reference for dual-screen behavior.

entries.title: Haunted Castle Revisited

emulation.notes: Use native PC collection.

primary.why: Haunted Castle Revisited debuts inside Dominus Collection as a redesigned remake of the arcade game, and PC is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Haunted Castle Revisited in Castlevania Dominus Collection on PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not a neutral port of Haunted Castle; it is a redesigned remake.
